title: Transform constant subtrees
description: You can follow a function that returns simplified nodes rather than just reading their values.

steps.description: The tree contains numbers, variables, and operations. constant_fold preserves number and variable leaves.
A minus applied directly to Num becomes a new Num. Other unary nodes rebuild their operand, while binary nodes first fold both children.

steps.question: After the children of 2 * (3 + 4) fold, can the outer multiplication fold too?
steps.answer: Yes. The inner sum becomes Num(7), so both outer operands are numbers.

steps.description: Numeric pairs fold through the listed arithmetic cases. Additional rules remove selected zero and one operands; unmatched cases rebuild a binary node.
pretty formats original and transformed trees side by side. The displayed cases include 14 for the nested constants and (6 + y) for a partly constant expression.
